name: cli-templates
body: CLI templates command: `kalide templates [--all] [name]` lists the deck's merged library's templates (the external library at the configured `templates:` path when set, and the deck-root `templates/` directory; see layered-template-library) or shows one template by name. The no-name form prints one line per template with its description, omitting a template whose manifest declares `internal: true` unless `--all` is passed (internal-templates); the named form prints the template's fields (type, required, default, limits, formats, description) — a `record` field showing its nested shape (record-item-type), and an `enum` field its effective variants, inline `variants:` or expanded from `variants_from:` at library load (enum-variants-from) — its child sections — for a slide template the sections it declares, for a section template the sections it can hold — each with the section templates it accepts and its min/max repeats, its body rules and its example, under usage-dependent headings (slide: `Sections:`/declares; section: `Child sections:`/Can hold). Owns internal/cli/templates.go — the command handler `runTemplates` and its printers (`printTemplateList`, `printTemplateDetails`, `printTemplateFields`, `printTemplateSections`, `printTemplateBody`, `printTemplateExample` and helpers) — the CLI presentation half of domain.service.template-registry. The remaining CLI commands (init, init-library, start, version) stay on solution.component.cli-commands, and `check` and `render` on solution.component.cli-check and solution.component.cli-render.
